verdict.rationale: The pack shows that a public fellow.ai/pricing page exists and lists feature names, such as keyword tracking, transcript redaction and AI summaries. It also confirms paid plans and an Enterprise plan exist. However, nothing shows a free tier, any price, which features belong to which tier, or whether basic use avoids a sales contact, so the story's core claims are unevidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start free and see exactly what each paid tier costs and adds — no "talk to sales" wall for basic use
